meta_title: Visit us: the OpenDrone workshop at Maakleerplek, Leuven
meta_description: OpenDrone is prototyped in the HighTechLab at Maakleerplek, a public makerspace in Leuven, Belgium. Walk through the lab in 3D, then come and see it during open lab hours.
title: Come see the lab.
lead: Incutec works from a room inside Maakleerplek, a public makerspace in Leuven. We prototype in its HighTechLab, on the same printers, CNC and laser cutter any member can use. The lab is open to everyone during open lab hours.
scan_body: A 3D scan of the HighTechLab, made from one walk through the room with a phone. Walk up to a machine to find out what it is. The scan is a 35 MB download and starts when you press the button.
scan_note: Early version. Parts of one wall and the ceiling were not scanned, and the game has only been tested on desktop Chrome so far.
scan_title_attr: 3D walkthrough of the HighTechLab at Maakleerplek
s1_body: [Maakleerplek](https://maakleerplek.be) is a non-profit public workshop in the Vaartkom in Leuven, with a textile lab, a print lab, a tool library, a canteen and the HighTechLab. Incutec's founding meeting was held there, in the loft, in April 2026.

We have used the HighTechLab's 3D printers, CNC and laser cutter for OpenDrone prototypes since 2025. Since June 2026 Incutec also has its own room in the building, under a written agreement with Maakleerplek vzw. Our founder volunteers in the HighTechLab, and we took part in Maakleerfest 2026.
s2_body: Open hardware is more than published files. Someone has to be able to pick up the design and make it, with tools they can actually get to. Working in a public lab keeps us honest about that: if we can prototype it here, so can you.

It also means you can walk in and ask. Bring a board, a broken frame or a question: the Incutec team works in the same building as the lab. For how the company and the community split the work, read [Open Source](/open-source).
hours_note: Hours are set by Maakleerplek and can change for holidays and events. Check [their agenda](https://maakleerplek.be/nl/agenda) for workshops and closures.
youngmakerlab_body: YoungMakerLab is the HighTechLab's programme for young makers, with sessions on Wednesday afternoons and Sunday mornings. See [Maakleerplek](https://maakleerplek.be/nl/meedoen) for how to join.
where_body: Buses 2, 6 and 30 stop close by at Vaartkom. The building has a lift on every floor.
Coming for OpenDrone? Ask anyone in the HighTechLab for us, or tell us on Discord when you plan to come so one of us is there.
